author: alvoron
title: smoke_ScaledAttnDynamic4D_GPU test crashes with SIGSEGV on iGPU
signature: smoke scaledattndynamic4d gpu scaledattnlayergputest comparewithref killed by signal sigsegv|Code Issue
root_cause: The iGPU functional test for GPU ScaledAttention (4D dynamic, f16, 20 heads, 64 head_size, no attention mask, with transpose, non-causal) crashes with SIGSEGV. This PR fixes an out-of-bounds read in CreateGatherOpBase() in the GPU plugin, but the failing test is ScaledAttnLayerGPUTest which appears unrelated to Gather. The SIGSEGV may indicate that the Gather OOB fix (accessing out_shape_original beyond bounds on the new shape-infer path) is inadvertently corrupting memory that affects the ScaledAttn kernel execution path. The PR modifies gather.cpp which handles shape inference for the Gather->Crop lowering optimization; an incorrect shape comparison could corrupt memory used by subsequent operations including attention kernels.
reproduction_steps: Run: ov_gpu_func_tests --gtest_filter='smoke_ScaledAttnDynamic4D_GPU/ScaledAttnLayerGPUTest.CompareWithRefs/netPRC=f16_IS=[?.20.?.64]_[?.20.?.64]_[?.20.?.64]_[?.1.?.?]_..._is_causal=0_has_attn=0_is_attn_const=1_has_scale=0_is_scale_const=1_with_transpose1_has_sink=0_' on an iGPU device
recommended_actions: Review the OOB fix in src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/plugin/ops/gather.cpp to ensure out_shape_original comparison is bounds-safe
Run the full iGPU ScaledAttn test suite locally with the PR change to reproduce the crash
Check if the SIGSEGV is deterministic or flaky by re-running the test multiple times
If the crash is deterministic, the PR likely introduces a memory corruption bug that must be fixed before merging
prevention_strategies: GPU plugin changes that modify shape inference paths should include targeted ScaledAttn regression tests, as memory layout changes can affect seemingly unrelated kernels.
historical_context: First occurrence of this specific SIGSEGV in smoke_ScaledAttnDynamic4D_GPU.
